name: Covered Call Ladder
summary: Split a multi-hundred share position into tranches and write calls at staggered strikes and expiries so the whole position is never called at once.
max_profit: sum of each tranche's capped gain plus all credits
max_loss: full share downside less total credits
breakevens: weighted average share basis - total credits per share

greeks.delta: +60 to +80 per 100 shares, smoothed across strikes
greeks.theta: positive, smoother than a single write

when_to_use: Positions of 300+ shares where a single strike would create a lumpy all-or-nothing outcome, and where the system wants a continuous income stream rather than monthly cliffs.
entry_rules: Each tranche independently satisfies the standard covered call entry gates (IVR >= 30, OI >= 250, credit >= 0.6% notional).
No two tranches share the same expiry date.
Total short call delta across tranches <= 0.45 x (shares/100).
management_rules: Manage each tranche independently at 50% profit / 21 DTE.
When a tranche closes, immediately re-write it at the longest rung so the ladder keeps its shape.
If aggregate short delta exceeds 0.55 per lot (a strong rally), roll the deepest tranche up-and-out for a credit before adding new rungs.
exit_rules: Per-tranche hard assignment guard: any ITM short call closed by 15:30 ET on its expiration day.
Extrinsic < 0.05 and delta > 0.85 on any rung triggers an immediate close of that rung.
If the whole position is being liquidated, close all short calls first, then sell shares.
assignment_risk: Each rung carries normal covered call assignment risk; the ladder's benefit is that at most one third of the position can be called in any one expiry. Ex-dividend guard must run per rung.
liquidity_needs: Needs a chain with multiple liquid expiries - monthlies plus weeklies with OI >= 250.
common_mistakes: Letting rungs drift onto the same expiry, which defeats the design; over-writing so aggregate delta is too short in a rally.
zero_dte_notes: The ladder concept is about spreading expiries; a 0DTE rung can be added as a tactical extra but is not part of the core structure.
family: Stock/ETF Shares Combined With Options (covered writes, protective hedges, collars, synthetics, repairs, conversions)
